import urllib.request
import json
import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

# Query NCBI Gene via E-utilities
def get_ncbi_gene_summary(symbol, taxid=9606):
    esearch_url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=gene&term={symbol}[Gene+Name]+AND+{taxid}[Taxonomy+ID]&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(esearch_url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as response:
        data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
    gene_id = data['esearchresult']['idlist'][0]
    
    esummary_url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=gene&id={gene_id}&retmode=json"
    req2 = urllib.request.Request(esummary_url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req2) as response:
        sum_data = json.loads(response.read().decode())
    return sum_data['result'][gene_id]

cc2d1b_ncbi = get_ncbi_gene_summary("CC2D1B")
mmp20_ncbi = get_ncbi_gene_summary("MMP20")

print("CC2D1B NCBI:")
print("Name:", cc2d1b_ncbi.get('name'))
print("Genomic info:", cc2d1b_ncbi.get('genomicinfo'))

print("\nMMP20 NCBI:")
print("Name:", mmp20_ncbi.get('name'))
print("Genomic info:", mmp20_ncbi.get('genomicinfo'))

import urllib.request
import json

def get_transcripts_ncbi(term):
    url = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esearch.fcgi?db=nuccore&term={term}+AND+Homo+sapiens[Organism]+AND+refseq[filter]&retmode=json"
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
        ids = json.loads(resp.read().decode())['esearchresult']['idlist']
    
    url2 = f"https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=nuccore&id={','.join(ids[:5])}&retmode=json"
    req2 = urllib.request.Request(url2, headers={'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0'})
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req2) as resp:
        res = json.loads(resp.read().decode())
    return [(res['result'][i]['caption'], res['result'][i]['title'], res['result'][i]['slen']) for i in ids[:5]]

print("CC2D1B transcripts:", get_transcripts_ncbi("CC2D1B[Gene+Name]+NM_*[Accession]"))
